the complete body records built-app consumer scenarios, while the latest commit changes only test consumers. | | **Patch quality** | 🦪 silver shellfish **(2/6)** | 1 actionable review finding remain. | ## Product **Kind:** Refactor · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Shared controls still depend on the legacy renderer while surrounding Control UI surfaces migrate to Solid. **Reason:** Maintainer authorship establishes direction, and the cutover retains shared component boundaries and caller-owned effects. ## Merge readiness ⛔ **Needs changes before merge - 3 items remain** Keep this PR open: the maintainer-directed migration is useful, but the previously reported ArrowUp selection regression remains. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `f87ae5022d02ad7246e9d9e397b594db85582a6b` ## Before merge - [ ] **Preserve the enabled selected choice when ArrowUp opens the picker (P2)** - With enabled choices Alpha, Beta, and Gamma and value Beta, ArrowUp on the closed trigger initializes Beta through the menu subscription, then this callback overwrites the highlight with Gamma. Enter consequently commits Gamma. The base prioritizes the enabled stored choice and uses the last row only as a fallback. Preserve that priority and cover ArrowUp reopening with an enabled current value. This repeats the unresolved prior finding; the latest commit leaves this production hunk unchanged. - [ ] **Complete next step** - Resolve the GitHub-reported merge conflict and classify the collaborator-scroll failures in the current real-Gateway job against base evidence before assigning any additional code repair. - [ ] **Explain or restore the original intent of Generic picker selection and search** - 932ae87ede92448e3e3d08d161faebb140d05904: Shared search preserves caller-owned selection, and the base opening logic prioritizes an enabled stored choice. ## Findings - [P2] Preserve the enabled selected choice when ArrowUp opens the picker — `ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx:123-126` ### Provenance - `Generic picker selection and search` changes intended behavior without addressing why it exists (932ae87ede92448e3e3d08d161faebb140d05904: Shared search preserves caller-owned selection, and the base opening logic prioritizes an enabled stored choice.)

Preserve that priority and cover ArrowUp reopening with an enabled current value. This repeats the unresolved prior finding; the latest commit leaves this production hunk unchanged. ([`ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx:123`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/f87ae5022d02ad7246e9d9e397b594db85582a6b/ui/src/components/select-picker-view.tsx#L123), [f87ae5022d02](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/f87ae5022d02ad7246e9d9e397b594db85582a6b)) - **Original selection contract:** Main prioritizes the enabled stored choice for either opening arrow; the last option is only a fallback.
